title: seed

title: metadata_csv

title: default_apply_all
description: Dimension order of the raw images (e.g. TCZYX = time, channel, z, y, x). Used to interpret every input image unless overridden per sample.

title: sink_channel
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.sink_channel' (type int, default 2).

title: source_channels
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.source_channels' (type str, default '0, 1').

title: train_z
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.train_z' (type str, default '4,5,6').

title: train_t
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.train_t' (type str, default '1,3,6').

title: bg_percentile
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.bg_percentile' (type int, default 1).

title: median_size
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.median_size' (type int, default 3).

title: gaussian_sigma
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.gaussian_sigma' (type int, default 4).

title: visualize_napari
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.visualize_napari' (type bool, default True).

title: training_log
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.training_log' (type bool, default False).

title: timepoints
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.timepoints' (type int, default 0).

title: use_all_timepoints
description: Process every timepoint. Disable to restrict to a [tp_start, tp_end] range.

title: use_range
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.use_range' (type bool, default False).

title: start_t
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.start_t' (type int, default 0).

title: end_t
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.end_t' (type int, default 0).

title: use_unmix_path
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.use_unmix_path' (type bool, default False).

title: channel_colors
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'signal_unmixing.channel_colors' (type list, default ['cyan', 'yellow', 'red', 'green', 'magenta', 'blue', 'gray', 'turbo', 'viridis', 'plasma', 'inferno', 'twilight']).

title: examples_per_sample
description: How many annotated example timepoints to draw per sample when training the pixel classifier. More examples = better but slower training.

title: sample_specific_classifier
description: Train a separate classifier per sample instead of one shared classifier. Use when samples differ a lot in appearance.

title: workers
description: Number of parallel CPU worker processes. Higher = faster but more RAM/CPU.

title: use_all_timepoints
description: Process every timepoint. Disable to restrict to a [tp_start, tp_end] range.

title: tp_start
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'pixel_classifier.tp_start' (type int, default 0).

title: tp_end
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'pixel_classifier.tp_end' (type int, default 0).

title: number_of_channels
description: Number of image channels passed to Cellpose.

title: extra_channel_slots
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose.extra_channel_slots' (type int, default 0).

title: labels_mode
description: 'same_for_all' applies one channel→cell-type label map to every sample; 'per_sample' lets each sample differ.

title: channel_labels
description: Mapping of channel index → cell-type name (e.g. {0: 'organoid', 1: 'tcell'}).

title: per_sample_channel_labels
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose.per_sample_channel_labels' (type dict, default {}).

title: model_name
description: Cellpose-SAM zero-shot model. cpsam and cpsam_v2 require no training and may be compared directly.

title: python_path
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.python_path' (type str, default '').

title: device
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.device' (type str, default 'auto').

title: force_cpu
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.force_cpu' (type bool, default False).

title: all_cell_types
description: Run each detected cell type in one Cellpose-SAM batch; every type still uses its own selected input channel(s) and output.

title: use_all_timepoints
description: Process every timepoint. Disable to restrict to a [tp_start, tp_end] range.

title: tp_start
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.tp_start' (type int, default 0).

title: tp_end
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.tp_end' (type int, default 0).

title: preview_sample
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.preview_sample' (type str, default '').

title: preview_timepoint
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.preview_timepoint' (type int, default 0).

title: diameter
description: Expected Cellpose-SAM object diameter. Leave at 0 for automatic sizing unless objects are well outside the model's roughly 7.5-120 pixel training range.

title: flow_threshold
description: Maximum Cellpose-SAM flow error. Default 0.4; raise it to keep more imperfect shapes or lower it for stricter shapes. Ignored in 3D mode.

title: cellprob_threshold
description: Cellpose-SAM cell probability threshold. Lower it to detect more or larger objects; raise it to reject dim or uncertain detections.

title: niter
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.niter' (type int, default 0).

title: do_3D
description: Use full 3D Cellpose-SAM segmentation for accuracy. Disable for speed or highly anisotropic Z data, then tune slice stitching.

title: stitch_threshold
description: IoU threshold for stitching 2D masks across Z. Used only when Cellpose-SAM 3D segmentation is disabled.

title: flow3D_smooth
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.flow3D_smooth' (type float, default 0.0).

title: batch_size
description: Cellpose-SAM GPU patch batch size. Reduce this first after a CUDA out-of-memory error; it affects throughput and memory, not segmentation quality.

title: min_size
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.min_size' (type int, default 1).

title: max_size_fraction
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.max_size_fraction' (type float, default 1.0).

title: norm_percentile_low
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.norm_percentile_low' (type float, default 1.0).

title: norm_percentile_high
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.norm_percentile_high' (type float, default 99.0).

title: norm3D
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.norm3D' (type bool, default True).

title: sharpen_radius
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.sharpen_radius' (type float, default 0.0).

title: smooth_radius
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.smooth_radius' (type float, default 0.0).

title: tile_norm_blocksize
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.tile_norm_blocksize' (type float, default 0.0).

title: tile_norm_smooth3D
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.tile_norm_smooth3D' (type float, default 0.0).

title: invert
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.invert' (type bool, default False).

title: drop_2d_segments
description: Remove flat single-slice fragments after Cellpose-SAM. Keep enabled unless real objects genuinely occupy one slice.

title: size_filter
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.size_filter' (type dict, default {}).

title: channel_selection
description: BEHAV3D parameter 'cellpose_sam.channel_selection' (type dict, default {}).

title: track_organoids_together
description: Track all organoids as a single merged object rather than individually.

title: method
description: Tracking algorithm selected from measured behavior, not a biological name. Use Fragmentation Propagation (stored as 'propagation') for objects that overlap themselves between frames and may fragment; Bounded Propagation for overlapping or touching objects whose track IDs must remain within one connected region; btrack when objects lose frame-to-frame overlap; and Reporter Propagation only for static objects with intermittent fluorescence. LapTrack and TrackPy need a specific reason.

title: overwrite
description: Re-run and overwrite existing outputs instead of skipping completed samples.

title: track_cost_px
description: LapTrack frame-to-frame linking cost cutoff in pixels (akin to a max move distance).

title: gap_close_cost_px
description: LapTrack cost cutoff for bridging gaps where a cell was briefly undetected.

title: gap_close_max_frames
description: Maximum gap length (frames) LapTrack will bridge when gap-closing.

title: merging_cost_px
description: LapTrack cost for allowing two tracks to merge (0 disables merging).

title: splitting_cost_px
description: LapTrack cost for allowing a track to split (0 disables splitting).

title: search_range_px
description: Max distance (pixels) a cell may move between consecutive frames. Set just above the fastest expected displacement; too small drops links, too large makes spurious ones.

title: memory_frames
description: How many frames a cell may disappear (occlusion/missed detection) and still be re-linked to the same track.

title: adaptive_stop
description: trackpy adaptive-search lower bound; linking subdivides the search range down to this value when ambiguous.

title: adaptive_step
description: Factor by which trackpy shrinks the search range on each adaptive subdivision (0–1).

title: config_preset
description: btrack motion-model preset: 'cell' (typical migrating cells) or 'particle' (fast, near-random motion).

title: config_path
description: Optional path to a custom btrack config JSON; overrides the preset.

title: use_visual_features
description: Use image-derived intensity measurements alongside motion for btrack linking. This is separate from global track optimization.

title: max_search_radius
description: btrack maximum linking radius in physical distance units (normally micrometres after metadata scaling).

title: update_method
description: btrack hypothesis update: 'EXACT' (accurate, slower) or 'APPROXIMATE' (faster for large datasets).

title: step_size
description: btrack processing chunk size. Leave it unchanged unless tracking runs out of memory; lower it to reduce RAM at the cost of more stitching overhead.

title: n_workers
description: Parallel workers for this step.

title: use_optimize
description: Run btrack's global optimisation pass (better tracks, slower).

title: hypotheses
description: btrack hypotheses to evaluate (P_FP false-positive, P_init initialisation, P_term termination, P_link linking, P_branch division).

title: dist_thresh
description: btrack optimizer distance threshold in physical distance units (normally micrometres after metadata scaling).

title: time_thresh
description: btrack time threshold (frames) for candidate links.
